Before the marked occurrence starts and after it ends, each source character may be kept or skipped, giving diagonal factor2; while inside the occurrence, nonmatching intervening characters must be skipped, giving diagonal factor1. Matching the next pattern character advances one state. These lower-triangular linear transformations compose over concatenated Fibonacci words as T(F_i)=T(F_(i-2))*T(F_(i-1)). The final entry from initial state0 to completed staten counts all occurrences, including overlaps and distinct index selections yielding equal strings, without constructing exponential-length words.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
